non-blocking: The module docstring promises a recomputation of every derived figure, but test_the_record_quotes_the_bands_it_measured:158-161 reads the axis offset and both flux fractions verbatim from receipt['band_rows'] instead of re-deriving them from receipt['efit'] and receipt['generating'] (derived() at :78 recomputes only the current fractions and the span ratio), so a receipt whose derived rows disagree with its own raw states would still pass; the profile_amplitudes and solver strings receipt.json:184-204 carries are likewise hand-typed literals in the uncommitted write_receipt.py rather than reads from a record.
